observations.finding: The foreground overhead horizontal spans remain visible in the new field view, then no longer cross the party in the two combat views. Ashley now has a visible head, torso, arms and both legs before and after the native shot, unlike the two frozen historical combat frames. Two rachni silhouettes are unobscured. The central rachni has a separate remaining pillar occlusion, so this does not certify all three bodies as unobscured.

Both newly opened board captures show the complete extraction marker7 and its surrounding southern terrain inside the map board. No toast covers the plan. The map has been scrolled into view using real scrolling; the header can move partly above the viewport. This supplies the missing scrolled view without changing the historical initial map capture.

The final mobile capture shows the entire numbered extraction row7 and its label inside the visible list area after nested native scrolling. This demonstrates visible access after scrolling; it does not claim the complete plan, header and list always fit simultaneously or that a new extraction click was performed.

The preserved driver inputs import unchanged real exports with the public chooser. The Noveria export descends from the older explicitly prepared progression fixture; the Eden export comes from the prior actual keyboard-travelled checkpoint. The encounter report records one natural-ATB shot and exact downloaded precombat restoration. The map-only report records scrollIntoViewIfNeeded/native wheel and natural toast expiry, without CSS/scene/pose injection or direct scrollTop assignment. These functional claims remain attributed to their original reports rather than inferred from screenshots.

residualFindings.finding: The middle rachni is still partially hidden by a foreground vertical side pillar in both new combat views. The targeted overhead beam/Ashley obstruction is corrected, but all three enemy silhouettes are not wholly unobscured.

The supplement proves a clear map after natural toast expiry and actual scrolling. It does not remove the earlier initial map/toast overlap, certify gameplay HUD/radar at390px or establish a physical-phone interaction/performance result.

acceptance: Qualified pass for the targeted overhead-beam/Ashley correction and the requested scrolled map evidence. Six accepted images were actually opened and their hashes verified. All three rachni are not certified unobscured; no strict full browser run is claimed.
limitations: The two negative raw reports retain passed:false and their original failures. Accepted encounter frames are a successful sub-result before a later faulty map observer; the separate final map-only execution supplies the map evidence. No complete uninterrupted rerun is represented.

Only visible states and framing were independently judged. Mesh registration, merge exclusions, collision behavior, native damage values, save restoration and browser cleanup are supported by the input runner/unit evidence rather than deduced from pixels.

Original campaign progression/recruitments before the imported Noveria export were not played in the new browser proof. The new map proof imports the prior real Eden checkpoint and does not replay the earlier walk.
The central rachni remains partly occluded by a side pillar. The old broader Eden prototype, low-contrast KO and mobile gameplay coverage limits remain historical and are not silently cleared.

The six accepted PNGs, six linked reports, runtime sources, all61 current dist files and the three executed archived driver hashes were checked. The reviewer modified only this new JSON supplement; no source, screenshot, atlas, older report or build was changed.
